issues.existing: torn paper or parchment sheet split by the blade
issues.observed: an open book/codex lying face-up on the slab, its two pages spread; the central line is the spine gutter, not a tear
issues.evidence: The pale object has a V-shaped valley running from under the sword tip down toward the viewer, with a page plane rising away on each side — the gutter of an open book. Along the front edge, below that valley, there is a visible wedge of stacked page edges giving the object real thickness, which a single flat sheet could not have. The two outer edges curve up slightly as bound pages do. Nothing in the object reads as a ragged or cut separation.
